items.hed: Texans play the winless Chargers this afternoon at SoFi Stadium
items.insight: The club's official game page has kickoff today, Sunday, Nov. 8, at 3:05 p.m. Central at SoFi Stadium, broadcast on NFL Network and CBS. Houston enters at 2-5; Los Angeles enters at 0-6. The Texans' Week 9 injury report, posted by the club Friday, tracked practice participation through the week ahead of today's game.
items.image_caption: NRG Stadium interior. Ed Schipul, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0.

items.hed: The Rockets fell to 7-3 after Devin Booker's late run lifted Phoenix to a 102-99 win Saturday night
items.insight: CBS Sports reported Booker scored 24 points, including seven straight to break a late tie, as the Suns held off Houston 102-99 Saturday at Phoenix. The loss snapped Houston's five-game winning streak and dropped the Rockets to 7-3 on the season. Houston returns home Monday, Nov. 9, at 7:30 p.m. Central to host the Denver Nuggets at Toyota Center.

items.hed: New GM Randy Flores heads into this week's GM meetings with the Astros' manager opening still unfilled
items.insight: A Houston Chronicle report carried by Yahoo Sports Saturday said Flores enters the league's GM meetings with a manager to hire, roster questions to weigh, and a possible Dec. 1 labor lockout looming over the sport. Flores has been linked to former Astros teammates Albert Pujols and Morgan Ensberg, along with Rangers bench coach Luis Urueta, for the job left open by Joe Espada. As of Saturday no hire had been announced; owner Jim Crane has said the interview process began before Flores was even hired.
